copy.headline: This result combines more reported stress-related experiences with lower Extraversion.
copy.body: These scores do not establish whether you express feelings, how you recover, or whether you carry a hidden long-term burden. Review one specific experience and record feelings, expression, interest in interaction, and what changed afterward separately.
copy.strength_sentence: You may notice your own unease while preferring less group interaction. Check the situation before concluding that a danger or relationship problem exists.
copy.risk_sentence: If you notice a difference between your worries and willingness to express them, record what you felt and actually said. The scores alone do not establish a hidden internal burden.
copy.context_boundary: You can observe group, one-to-one, and solitary settings separately. Use specific experiences to check whether a pattern recurs rather than predicting it from these two scores.
copy.action_hook: If you want to explore further, choose one low-risk experience and record feelings, expression, and subsequent changes separately before deciding whether any adjustment or support is useful.
